terms_note: Confirm the data source's terms of use before redistributing. Adjusted OHLC uses the Adj Close/Close ratio; returns are total-return adjusted. Raw close is retained for dollar-volume approximation.
survivorship_note: The list was fixed as of 2019-01-02 but necessarily contains companies that survived through the evaluation window. Historical index membership was not used. Results may be optimistic relative to a true point-in-time universe.
